title: SLUM-i: Semi-supervised Learning for Urban Mapping of Informal Settlements and Data Quality Benchmarking
abstract: arXiv:2602.04525v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Very-high-resolution remote-sensing imagery provides a scalable basis for delineating informal settlements, but sparse annotations, severe imbalance between informal-settlement and background pixels, and cross-city heterogeneity in urban morphology and image--mask correspondence complicate model development. We present SLUM-i, a semi-supervised semantic segmentation framework together with a geographically diverse seven-city Earth observation benchmark spanning three continents. The benchmark combines a newly annotated Lahore dataset and companion Karachi and Mumbai datasets with four publicly released city datasets, totaling 14,458 RGB image--mask tiles. We quantify cross-city heterogeneity using class composition, boundary morphology, grayscale separability, correspondence between mask boundaries and image edges, and divergence between measured feature distributions. translated_title: SLUM-i：非正规住区城市制图的半监督学习与数据质量基准评估
translated_abstract: 超高分辨率遥感影像为描绘非正规住区提供了可扩展的基础，但稀疏的标注、非正规住区与背景像素之间的严重不平衡，以及城市形态和影像-掩膜对应关系的跨城市异质性，给模型开发带来了挑战。我们提出了SLUM-i，一个半监督语义分割框架，并附带一个地理多样化的七城市地球观测基准，覆盖三大洲。该基准结合了新标注的拉合尔数据集、配套的卡拉奇和孟买数据集，以及四个公开的城市数据集，共计14,458个RGB影像-掩膜图块。我们通过类别组成、边界形态、灰度可分离性、掩膜边界与影像边缘的对应关系，以及实测特征分布之间的差异来量化跨城市异质性。为了实现标签高效制图，SLUM-i结合了表示...
tldr: SLUM-i提出了一种半监督语义分割框架和一个七城市基准，通过量化跨城市异质性，在有限标注下高效绘制非正规住区地图。
en_tdlr: SLUM-i introduces a semi-supervised semantic segmentation framework and a seven-city benchmark, quantifying cross-city heterogeneity to efficiently map informal settlements with limited annotations.
